notes.title: Update 1.001
notes.notes:
Fix: 
1. Background image of dungeon thumbnail is corrupt in dungeon selection screen when dungeon is too big (20*20).
2. Clear single equipment slot inside dungeon cause error.
3. BGM changes too frequently during tutorial.

notes.title: Update 0.755
notes.notes:
1. Add Death Panel in case player don't know what happened after character death. Player can check "Do Not Show Again" to avoid interruption in future, also can enable it again in option panel.
2. Change unavailable game features in tutorial from totally invisible to transparent.
3. Remake Skill Videos for skill description panel since UI change.
4. Add Space to cancel skill since ESC key is inconvenience.
5. Fix: Jump skill shows able to jump left and right but unable to use it that way.
6. Fix: Skill icons are inconsistent with actual skill video.
7. Fix: Other minor bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.739
notes.notes:
1. After got 3 star in dungeon and went back, it only show 2 star.
2. After quit and restart game, the new score and rank doesn't update properly.
3. Retrieve Data function in Option window doesn't work properly.
4. After switch dungeon difficulty at left, the stars in dungeon floor window doesn't update properly.
5. Other minor issues.

notes.title: Update 0.732
notes.notes:
1. Adjustment of maximum skill and equipment slots for dungeons.
2. Adjustment for skill range according to character property, such as Distance Break, now it has 2 minimum shooting distance even the Control property is 0;

Fixes:
1. Quiting from Tutorial dungeons will leave 3 pieces same skill and equipment.
2. Open and Close skill dialog too quick will cause skill animation stick on screen.
3. Getting Key or Remote Control just before death will cause character death with standing animation.
4. Push box into stone skill doesn't work
5. Skill name at top left doesn't fit the actually skill in dungeon.
6. Character property numbers are incorrect when changing skill and equipment inside dungeon.
7. Last achievement name is overlapped with button.
8. Equipment image shows out of the frame.
9. Equipped icon is overlapped with name tag
10. Many text issues, too small, too big, inappropriate color.

notes.title: Major Update 0.703
notes.notes:
1. Total UI style remake.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31931329/3d4c200f8c776d8928ca820e3363f73c7c1a1906.jpg


2. Simplify the game play process. Remove big world map and many dungeons. 
Just choose the difficulty you want to challenge and then start.
Remove the complicated trial thing, just following the difficulty.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31931329/0bba055121af576218845335b0585c30b69ef4af.jpg


3. Simplify Skill and Equipment system. 
Merged similar skills and reduced the total count of them. make them easy to remember.
Also no need to unlock them. Player can use all of them from start. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31931329/688fe5fff8002687c12cc89687098b8addc6cf25.jpg


4. Slow the tutorial pace down. Avoid putting too many information in such a short time period. Add a few dungeons in between tutorials and also add a few more description of easily confusing things.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31931329/09a64650e1e8963a11f2e558bd86b9c183aaede2.jpg


5. Adjustment for character initial property and equipment property according to skill system changes.

6. Adjustment for achievement since game elements changed. The adjustment system works fine, just no pictures yet.

7. Many many many bugs fixed.

notes.title: Update 0.615
notes.notes:
Came back from holidays.

New:
1. Add Standard Steps and World Record Steps label. Displays at top all time inside dungeon. Easy to understand how far to get the 2nd and 3rd Star.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31931329/5bbca1ae31fcb8000e2308392eccc0d6b48a1b48.png
2. Add option to change control method from WASD to Arrow Keys.
3. Add Arrow Keys Control Method into Hotkey instruction window.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31931329/6cc0dc1326dfbbd41eccce1fc7f85e9fe7155d4f.png

Fix:
1. 8 redundant floors shows in Elite Trial Dungeon after floor 24. 
2. Shortcut key 1 2 3 for switch weapon/skill doesn't work.
3. Rank entries displays overlapped inside dungeon if there are over 10 entries.

notes.title: Update 0.613
notes.notes:
It's Chinese New Year now, I may not be able to update in time in this week, don't worry, I will catch up when I come back.

Fixes: 
1. When enter a dungeon, this first equipment should be shown as selected.
2. After change equipment or item, the highlight shows previously selected equipment, but actually it should be reset.
3. Add limitation for early dungeons, player only be able to use just unlocked equipment and item. So player can seek the best record right way, no need for later get better equipment and item to come back for better record.

notes.title: Update 0.611
notes.notes:
New: 
  - Add Tutorial content into ? mark. Make it able to check inside dungeons.
 
 
Fixes:
 - Need click character twice to refresh equipment inventory correctly inside dungeons
 - Reset Equipment after tutorial to prevent cheating
 - R and F reversed in shortcut description
 - Allow change Items in tutorial 15
 - Tutorial 15 is too easy to solve without skills
 - Tutorial 8 is too hard to get the second star
 - Character panel is overlapped by tutorial shadow
 - Default equipment and item should be empty
 - Highlight for current selected skill is not clear enough to notice
 - Font size in Skill Description and Dungeon Floor selection panel is too small
 - Tutorial 1 and 2, the shadow covered Return button in top right, make it unable to quit game normally
 - Fix grammar issues

Special thanks to Nefer for many feedback.
